title: What If a Year Without Summer Happened Again?

scenes.text: What if the summer simply didn't come? It already happened once, and it started with a volcano.
In April 1815, Mount Tambora erupted. Ash and sulfur gas blocked sunlight around the planet.
Within a year, global temperatures fell by roughly half a degree Celsius or more.
In June 1816, snow fell in New England. Harvests failed across Europe and Asia.
Food prices soared. Hunger spread, and typhus killed more than sixty-five thousand people.
Stuck indoors that gloomy summer, Mary Shelley began writing Frankenstein.

description:
What if a year without summer happened again?
In 1816, after the Tambora eruption, June snow hit New England and harvests failed across Europe.
What should we run through next?
